storage: Keep unpeeled at room temperature away from ripe bananas. Peeled pieces blacken fast: keep in water with a little lemon or turmeric and cook the same day; refrigerate only cooked plantain.
looksLike: A green, angular banana with a thick skin and firm, starchy white flesh. Nendran is the large Kerala plantain; ordinary green banana (kaccha kela) is smaller.
howToPick: Firm, fully green, blemish-free fingers with an intact stem. Avoid yellowing fruit, which has turned sweet and loses resistant starch, and avoid soft, split or black-spotted skin.
shelfLife: A few days to about a week at room temperature, longer while still green (general guidance; not taken from a source in this run).
